notes.title: Block Editor for Ablockalypse
notes.notes:
[p]Ablockalypse now has a block editor which allows you to modify the shapes of the blocks.

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40827785/a1e2d78b73e16c3ecabdc223664a34818155d1a9.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p]For additional details please see the the following steam guide, or youtube video below. [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3508799557"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="2B0x6lrGWxM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
This update also includes some minor bug fixes.[/p][list][*][p]Ensure blocks are regenerated when exiting and starting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Ensure the y axis is correct for blocks put into play regardless of shape or size so that the bottom of the block lines up with the top of the board.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Ablockalypse adds a wall kick.
notes.notes: [p]A wall kick has been added to Ablockalypse. When you try to rotate a brick next to a wall that wont fit it will move to the side a bit so that it can rotate.[/p]

notes.title: Ablockalypse now has a grid guide.
notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Add the guide grid option which allows for different colors.[/p][/*][*][p]The gamepad now uses the user option for input delay and repeat to match how the keyboard works.[/p][/*][*][p]Add localization to the Board Size, Input Delay Input Repeat and Guide Grid labels in the options.


[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Delay and Repeat input options available.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Options now available for keyboard input Delay and Repeat.
[*] Adjusted the 'J' and 'L' block rotations slightly.
[/list]

notes.title: Add transparent layer between block and background.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Add a transparent layer between the blocks and background. This visual change makes it easier to distinguish between the blocks and the background.
[/list]

notes.title: Ablockalypse has all new backgrounds now.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] A whole new set of backgrounds make Ablockalypse look amazing.
[*] Some minor tweaks to the options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Ablockalypse now has a full soundtrack.
notes.notes: Immerse yourself in the uplifting and vibrant sounds of sweet Jazz in this free soundtrack update.

notes.title: Ablockalypse 0.6.3.1 Now Available!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix bug where the combo score wasn't cleared on a new game.
[*] Fix bug where the language preference wasn't saved and loaded on the next run.
[*] Fix bug where the cursor wasn't pulsing when entering a high score.
[*] Fix bug where background may not show after an update on Linux.
[/list]

notes.title: Ablockalypse is now available in Spanish. Sí, hermoso español.
notes.notes:
* Options->Language->Spanish to select the Spanish language. Currently the language needs to be set manually. (In a later update the language will be set based on your steam preferences.)

* Fonts now render much more smoothly.

notes.title: Ablockalypse 0.6.2.1 Now Available.
notes.notes:
Ablockalypse 0.6.2.1 Now Available.

[list]
[*]Now hiding mouse pointer as it's not used.
[*]Put the boardsize option inline with the rest of the option elements.
[/list]

notes.title: Ablockalypse 0.6.2.0 Major Input Update
notes.notes:
* Completely updated the input system to make it much more fluid
* Added gamepad support.

notes.title: Ablockalypse 0.6.0.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
This is a major update as we are nearing the 1.0 release.

* You can now change the size of the playing board by going to the options and you can select a board size anywhere between 8x8 and 25x22.

* Remember to use space for fast drop.

notes.title: Ablockalypse 0.3.0.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Use a more natural curve for increasing the speed for each level. The speed increases a bit faster for the early levels.
[*] There were some cases where the first few blocks were repeated. The random number generator was updated to ensure this doesn't happen.
[*] Add a quick drop feature to quickly move the block down to the bottom by using the space bar.
[*] Completely reworked the scoring, which is much for fun now. Also added combos to the scoring.
[/list]

notes.title: Ablockalypse 0.2.6.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
* Now you can add your name to the high score list when making a new high score.
* New font to display scores, etc.
* Next block is now centered

notes.title: Ablockalypse Ver 0.2.5.0 now Available!
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Backgrounds now fade in when starting play and cross fade when progressing through the levels.
[*] New company logo.
[*] Add credits to the main menu.
[*] Menu items now have a fading highlight instead of a flickering highlight.
[*] Updated the font for the main menu items.
[*] Fix a bug where incomplete lines were counted as complete lines in some cases.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ablockalypse 0.2.0.1
notes.notes: Fix an issue where the frame rate was much lower than expected. The game now runs at the expected frame rate.
